decision: D-014 (option B): Non-PR GitHub writes that use a draft already in the planning folder, exactly as drafted, at the point the plan says, are pre-approved (filing NEW tickets, close-out and status comments, label changes, named reassignments, assigning #6201, the note to Scott). Only PR links, merge SHAs and new ticket numbers are filled in. Still stops for polfer: a write with no draft, any change to a draft's substance, a close the outcome doesn't support, any deletion, anything touching repository settings. polfer still OKs each phase exit and merges every PR.
